findings.title: An ordinary second open bypasses the discard confirmation
reproduction: Click New theme draft (or Resume/Reload): confirmation appears and text remains.
Without selecting Discard, click ordinary New theme draft again (or another Resume/Reload).
findings.actual: pending is non-null, so dirty && pending === null is false; open proceeds and replaces form then clears dirty.
findings.expected: Every ordinary open must preserve dirty form unless the user explicitly confirms discard.
findings.test_gap: Existing browser sequence exercises Keep then explicit Discard, but not another ordinary navigation while confirmation remains visible.
findings.recommended_repair: Separate guarded requestOpen from explicit discard-confirmed load (or pass an explicit discard authorization only from confirmation). Keep every ordinary navigation guarded independent of pending; clear/rebind pending state on save/open as appropriate. Add a focused regression for repeated ordinary New and alternate Resume/Reload while pending.

findings.title: Receipt format is overwritten with passed
findings.actual: format="passed"; original immutable receipt retained and all 26 artifact hashes verify.
findings.recommended_repair: Use separate format/version and formatting_check fields in a prospective supplemental receipt; do not mutate the original evidence.
